source.name: BAL via APO Group: Basketball Africa League and Qatar Foundation Announce Multiyear Social Impact Collaboration
source.quote: a multiyear collaboration that makes Qatar Foundation the BAL’s first Official Community Partner
source.note: Multiyear collaboration facilitated by Qatar Sports Investments, beginning with the 2026 BAL season; QF is also the Presenting Partner of the BAL's Ubuntu Trophy. No deal value reported. League-wide partner, attached to no single club.
